resume: Bytemania is a bytebeat synth: a one-line formula in t yields an 8-bit sample at each step, and the note played sets the speed of t (middle C at 8 kHz). The knobs change the numbers in the formula while it plays; you write your own formulas on the device.

commandes.role: Octave, from minus 2 to plus 2. In the editor: deletes before the cursor.
Octave up. In the editor: deletes after the cursor.
Changes the view: the grid (default) or the oscilloscope. In the editor, held: the second key layer.
Keys play or select a patch; when selecting, keys 1 to 27 take patches 01 to 27.
Tapped: next voice mode (MONO, DUAL, POLY, MULTI). Held: the knobs set detune, offset and width.
The formula editor, on the formula that is playing; press again to return to the main screen.
The CC screen: 12 bindings from a MIDI CC to a parameter, between a minimum and a maximum.
Held: KNOB 1 to 4 set the variables e to h instead of a to d.
The save screen, on the playing patch or the first free slot (64 in all); press SAVE again to name it.
In the editor: a random formula, auditioned before it is offered (nothing silent or pure noise).
Tapped: the loop runs or stops. Held: the knobs set the loop (START, FINE, LEN, MODE OFF, LOOP or PING).
In MULTI: shows the left or right side. In the editor: a held C4 to listen.
On the CC screen: learn, the next CC received goes to the selected binding.
The glide, from 0 to 10. In the editor: moves the cursor.
The patch: the 30 built-in ones, then your slots.
Play in mono: the last note held sounds, and releasing it brings back the previous one. In the editor they type the formula: white keys t a b c d e f g h ( ) + - * & |, black keys 0 to 9 and ^.

gestes: HOME held + KNOB 1 to 4: variables e to h.
SEQ held + KNOB 1 to 4: the loop.
LFO held + KNOB 1 to 3: detune, offset, width (DUAL, MULTI).
In the editor, FX held: the second layer, with the operators for division, modulo, comparison, shift and logic, and on the black keys 0x, A to F, space (the README table lists them).

modes.texte: KNOB 1 to 4 set a to d (0 to 255), each in its own color on its knob and in the formula; turned fast, they advance by 8.
Every change compiles immediately; if it does not compile, the line under the formula says what and where, and the last valid version keeps playing. ENV: an empty patch.

a_savoir: USB MIDI: notes on any channel with velocity, pitch bend of plus or minus 2 semitones, and 12 learned CC bindings.
